data.text:
Now I'll run SQL queries to calculate:
1. Total 2017 revenue (non-canceled orders)
2. Health beauty category revenue in 2017 (non-canceled orders)
3. The share percentage

args.sql:
WITH total_2017 AS (
    SELECT SUM(oi.price) as total_revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
      AND o.order_status != 'canceled'
      AND o.order_status != 'unavailable'
),
health_beauty_2017 AS (
    SELECT SUM(oi.price) as health_beauty_revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
      AND o.order_status != 'canceled'
      AND o.order_status != 'unavailable'
      AND ct.product_category_name_english = 'health_beauty'
)
SELECT 
    total_revenue,
    health_beauty_revenue,
    ROUND(health_beauty_revenue * 100.0 / total_revenue, 2) as health_beauty_share_pct
FROM total_2017, health_beauty_2017
args.purpose: Calculate health_beauty category share of 2017 revenue
